items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed for the managed fleet and blocked for SearchWoot public exposure. Fleet-doctor has no run or checks; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error sweeps; therefore authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, monitoring, incident response, and disclosure readiness are unknown. No TLS certificates are reported as expiring within 30 days, but this is not full TLS validation. Compliance records 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Operational signals include 41 failed implementation requests, 46 open repair items, and 69 retained executive tick failures; these are risk signals, not proof of compromise. Recommend bounded read-only evidence capture only, with no credentials, private containers, exploitation, permission changes, or production mutation. Ordinary reversible SEO work may proceed conditionally when it adds no data use or security exposure.
